question: The oceanic crust mainly consists of _______ and ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**silica, magnesium.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **oceanic crust **is primarily composed of **silica and magnesium.**
 
• **Silica** makes up about **50% of the oceanic crust, **while **magnesium **makes up about **35%.**
 
• **Silica **is a mineral that is commonly **found in rocks** and is known for its** high melting point, hardness, and chemical stability.**
 
• **Magnesium** is a **lightweight metal** that is commonly found in **seawater **and is known for its** high strength-to-weight ratio **and its ability to** resist corrosion.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Silica and alumina are both minerals that are commonly found in** rocks,** but **alumina** is **not **a major component of the oceanic crust.
 
• Magnesium and alumina are both minerals that are commonly found in** rocks, **but alumina is not a major component of the oceanic crust.
 
• Iron is a mineral that is commonly found in rocks, but it is** not **a major component of the oceanic crust.
